# Valeem

> Valeem is an online education company that has taught live since 2019. It offers three programmes:
> Online Tuition (one-to-one live classes for IGCSE, O Level and A Level, plus support from Grade 5),
> Skills & Courses (coding, IELTS, English, languages and Quran) and Homeschool Pathways.
> Valeem has 650+ vetted educators and students in 14+ countries. About 70% of its families live in
> the Middle East, most of them in Saudi Arabia; many are Pakistani families living in the Gulf.

## Programmes
- Online Tuition: one-to-one live online classes for IGCSE, O Level and A Level (usually Grade 8 upwards),
  in every subject offered for these exams in schools in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia,
  with syllabus coverage and past-paper practice. Younger students from Grade 5 get English, Maths and
  homework support. Page: https://www.valeem.com/online-tuition/
- Skills & Courses: Scratch coding for young learners; Python, SQL and Power BI for teenagers and adults;
  IELTS preparation, English improvement, language classes (English, Urdu, Arabic, Chinese and German) and Quran classes.
  Page: https://www.valeem.com/skills-courses/
- Homeschool Pathways: a structured online academic programme for homeschooled children,
  with three stages (Explorers ages 7-9, Innovators ages 10-12, Scholars ages 13-14) and
  guidance towards O Level, IGCSE and A Level. Valeem is not a Cambridge school or examination centre.
  Homeschool fees (PKR): enrolment 9,500 for all stages; monthly 11,000 (Explorers), 12,500 (Innovators),
  14,000 (Scholars); 10% sibling discount on monthly fees. Same fees for families outside Pakistan.
  Live online classes in small batches of 12-15 students. Page: https://www.valeem.com/homeschool-pathways/

## How teachers are selected
Every Valeem teacher passes four checks:
1. Application.
2. Proof of an A or B grade in the subject they teach, at O Level, IGCSE or A Level.
3. A one-to-one interview on subject knowledge, academic depth and confident teaching.
4. Onboarding and training: managing student and parent expectations, using AI, presentations and live classes.

## How fees work (Online Tuition)
Tuition is a monthly plan, invoiced each month. The fee depends on the grade or level, the number of months,
classes per week, class length and whether the family wants a fixed time slot. A counsellor shares the fee
after a free demo class. Many families pay from a Saudi or Pakistani bank account.

## How it works
1. A parent or student tells Valeem the level, subject or course, and goals.
2. The student takes a free live demo class at a time that suits the family.
3. Valeem matches a vetted teacher.
4. Once the family is happy, Valeem shares the monthly plan and invoice.
5. Classes continue month to month, scheduled for the family's time zone.

## Where we teach
Online, worldwide. Main regions: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and Pakistan.
